title: Palindrome Check
description:
Given a string $s$ consisting of lowercase English letters, determine whether it is a palindrome.

A string is a palindrome if it reads the same forwards and backwards.
inputFormat: The first line contains a single string $s$ ($1 \leq |s| \leq 10^5$) consisting of lowercase English letters.
outputFormat: Print "YES" if the string is a palindrome, "NO" otherwise.
constraints:
$1 \leq |s| \leq 10^5$
The string consists of lowercase English letters only.
